_note: Repair line items keyed by numeric card_id (1-19) per ac_data_repo.json fault_card_estimates. option_1 = basic repair tier; option_2 = repair + preventive-maintenance tier. DEC-088 compliant. 'preventive maintenance' is an explicitly-allowed framing. Board-reviewed 2026-06-18 (Mark Delgado): card 8 O2 corrected (Schrader cores + vacuum + pressure-test, not metering device); card 2 O2 'static pressure' -> 'airflow'.

us_fault_cards.option_1: Replace the worn run capacitor and test the motor startup
us_fault_cards.option_2: Replace the run capacitor, then check the contactor and motor draw as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Replace the clogged air filter and check airflow at the return
us_fault_cards.option_2: Replace the filter, clean the return grille, and check the return and supply airflow as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Replace the worn contactor and test the contactor pull-in
us_fault_cards.option_2: Replace the contactor, then check the capacitor and wiring connections as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Replace the blower motor and test airflow across the system
us_fault_cards.option_2: Replace the blower motor and capacitor, clean the blower wheel, and test airflow as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Clear the clogged condensate drain and flush the line
us_fault_cards.option_2: Clear the drain line, flush it, and add a float switch as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Find the wiring fault, repair the connection, and test the circuit
us_fault_cards.option_2: Repair the faulty wiring, secure the connections, and inspect the full harness as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Diagnose the error code and replace the control board
us_fault_cards.option_2: Replace the control board, then check the sensors and wiring tied to the fault code as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Find the leak, seal it, and refill the refrigerant charge
us_fault_cards.option_2: Find and seal the leak, refill the charge, then replace the Schrader cores, pull a deep vacuum, and pressure-test the joints as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Thaw the frozen coil, find the cause, and restore airflow
us_fault_cards.option_2: Thaw the coil, correct the airflow or charge issue behind it, and clean the coil as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Replace the compressor, recharge the refrigerant, and test full operation
us_fault_cards.option_2: Replace the compressor, add a hard-start kit and filter drier, and recharge as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Replace the ignitor or flame sensor and test the heat cycle
us_fault_cards.option_2: Replace the ignitor and flame sensor, clean the burners, and test the heat cycle as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Replace the reversing valve and recharge the heat pump
us_fault_cards.option_2: Replace the reversing valve and solenoid, recharge the system, and test both modes as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Seal the leaking duct sections and test airflow
us_fault_cards.option_2: Seal the duct leaks, reconnect loose runs, and insulate the joints as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Clean the dirty coil and check the system pressures
us_fault_cards.option_2: Clean both coils, check pressures, and rinse the condenser as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Replace the mismatched orifice or piston and verify the charge
us_fault_cards.option_2: Replace the metering piston, verify the charge, and check superheat and subcooling as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Tighten the loose terminal and test the connection
us_fault_cards.option_2: Tighten the terminals, inspect for heat damage, and check the full connection as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Recover the excess refrigerant and set the charge to spec
us_fault_cards.option_2: Set the charge to spec, verify superheat and subcooling, and check airflow as preventive maintenance

us_fault_cards.option_1: Run a load calculation and document the correct system size
us_fault_cards.option_2: Run a full load calculation, document the duct and airflow needs, and size a matched system

us_fault_cards.option_1: Replace the corroded indoor coil and recharge the system
us_fault_cards.option_2: Replace the corroded coil, refill the charge, and check the indoor air sources tied to corrosion as preventive maintenance
